title: PBS DMS vs Clearline: how the DMS, CRM and AI workflows fit
summary: Compare PBS DMS with our native CRM and AI workflows. Understand record ownership, service appointment requirements and pull-only Workplan sync.
body_markdown:
Our platform overlaps with PBS DMS around customer work, but the two serve different core jobs. PBS v10 APEX is a dealership management system. We provide a native CRM workspace and configured AI conversations, follow-up and appointment workflows.


If accounting, parts or core service operations are the problem, evaluate the DMS. If customers wait for answers or opportunities lose ownership, evaluate the customer workflow. The useful decision is which system owns each piece of work, not whether an AI product replaces a whole DMS.


## What PBS covers


[PBS v10 APEX](https://www.pbssystems.com/dms) publishes accounting, sales, service, parts, CRM and Digital Service Suite scope. Its[CRM page](https://www.pbssystems.com/crm) describes department/event communication templates, due-service calculations and internal sales tasks.


Evaluate those operational requirements directly when considering a PBS alternative. Our current CRM and AI capabilities do not establish replacement accounting, parts inventory or core repair-order operations.


## What we bring to the customer workflow


Our native[CRM](https://www.useclearline.com/product/crm) includes contacts, vehicles, opportunities, pipelines and tasks alongside conversation history. Related records, configured stages, views, assignees and due dates help your team manage the next step.


Our configured[inbound conversations](https://www.useclearline.com/product/inbound) ,[campaigns](https://www.useclearline.com/product/campaigns) and[scheduling](https://www.useclearline.com/product/scheduler) can support customer work around that workspace. You can enable booking, cancellation, rescheduling, inventory search and PBS-dependent repair-order status separately.


Those actions need the relevant data, calendar and permissions. Native CRM scope does not imply that every task or conversation outcome writes into PBS.

For the broader system-role decision, use the[dealership data and integrations hub](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/pillars/dealership-data-integrations) and the[customer data guide](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/centralizing-customer-data-for-dealerships) .


## Know the exact PBS sync directions


Our[PBS integration](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/clearline-pbs-systems-integration) has the following boundaries:


Object Supported mapping


Contacts Off, pull-only or two-way for supported new changes


Vehicles Off, pull-only or supported two-way; contacts must sync at the same or higher level


Service appointments Pull-only or two-way with a selected service calendar and mapped OP codes


Workplan events Pull-only


Workplan tasks / reminders Pull-only


Workplan appointments Pull-only into a separate calendar; no service OP-code mapping or booking notifications


Pulling service appointments requires contacts and vehicles enabled. Two-way service appointments require both contacts and vehicles to be two-way. Changing the selected service calendar clears OP-code mappings, so those mappings must be reviewed again.


These are object-specific rules. “Every outcome is written to the DMS” would be too broad. A task created in our CRM is not established as a two-way PBS Workplan update.


## Demonstrate a service booking and its failure path


Use a test customer, vehicle and permitted service:


1. Confirm the connected contact and vehicle and the configured service/calendar mappings.
2. Enable only the agent jobs permitted for the test and select the calendar.
3. Ask for a service time, reject the first option and confirm an eligible slot.
4. Inspect the service appointment in the system the team uses.
5. Reschedule or cancel only when those actions are allowed, then inspect the result again.
6. Repeat with no valid slot or a failed action. The customer must receive an honest next step and staff must own recovery.


Use our[PBS integration announcement](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/clearline-pbs-systems-integration) for launch context, then confirm directions and prerequisites in a[workflow demonstration](https://www.useclearline.com/demo) . Do not use a product illustration as proof that the store’s live configuration completed the action.


## Decide where customer work lives


If PBS remains the DMS, choose whether staff use its CRM, our customer workspace or a defined split by department/workflow. Agree on ownership for customers, opportunities, tasks, appointments and outreach.


A due-service audience may be identified in PBS or another approved source while we run a configured campaign. Specify the source, available fields, contact rules, reply owner and booking result. Avoid parallel messages from both systems to the same customer.


Using our platform as the primary CRM workspace requires a review of the store’s lead programs, retail tools, permissions, reports, history, exports and migration needs. The[AI CRM guide](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/ai-crm-car-dealership) explains that decision without treating it as a DMS replacement.


## Compare the complete operating cost


Request a proposal that names required connections, setup, mappings, usage, staff training and any products retained. A connection fee does not establish every desired read/write action. Get the exact scope before approving an implementation date.


Use the[automotive CRM pricing guide](https://www.useclearline.com/blog/automotive-crm-pricing) for the quote worksheet. Then[bring your PBS workflow to a demo with us](https://www.useclearline.com/demo) and follow the customer record, owned next step and actual appointment result.


## Frequently asked questions


Is your platform a PBS DMS alternative? +


Our platform is not established as a replacement for PBS accounting, parts or core DMS operations. We provide a native CRM workspace and configured customer workflows that can connect to PBS.


Do you have your own CRM? +


Yes. Our workspace includes contacts, vehicles, opportunities, configurable pipelines and linked tasks, with customer conversation context.


Can you create service appointments in PBS? +


Supported two-way service appointment sync requires contacts and vehicles two-way, a selected service calendar and OP-code mappings. Demonstrate the permitted booking and inspect the result on the actual setup.


Are PBS Workplan tasks and appointments two-way? +


No. Our integration supports pulling Workplan events, tasks/reminders and appointments from PBS. Workplan appointments use a separate calendar and do not send booking notifications.


Can staff keep using PBS CRM? +


Evaluate an alongside workflow with clear record and outreach ownership. Confirm how replies, tasks and appointments reach the responsible team and avoid duplicated communication.
